visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A waiter in a black formal suit, white shirt, and red tie holds a large wooden tray with both hands. On the tray is an exceptionally large burger secured by multiple long metal skewers. The background shows a refined hotel lobby area with warm, soft lighting and decorative wall panels. (2) A man wearing black-rimmed glasses and a simple black t-shirt sits at a dining table. He points enthusiastically towards the giant burger, which is positioned next to a standard-sized burger and two baskets of golden french fries for size comparison. He then begins to cut the giant burger with a knife. (3) The man uses his hands to squeeze a large, triangular slice of the burger. The slice reveals stacked layers of thick grilled beef patties, melted orange cheese, and several strips of glistening bacon. He brings the compressed slice to his mouth to take a large bite. (4) Close-up shots showcase the thick, juicy cross-section of the burger's interior meat and the textures of the melted cheese and bacon. The man continues to eat with an expression of surprise and delight. The final frame displays a printed menu board detailing a burger promotion at a venue.
